Formula 1 Driver Charles Leclerc Taken to Medical Center After Crash

Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc was taken to the medical center following a significant crash during the Italian Grand Prix. The incident occurred at the Monza circuit. Following the crash, Leclerc provided an update on his health.
